exp.desc:
- Reach and VNA up to 12 m
- Put-away, picking, loading
- Inducting new colleagues

cl.p1: twelve-metre racking, narrow aisles and pallets of glass bottles have been my workplace for five years at a drinks wholesaler. I operate reach and very-narrow-aisle machines and have had no reportable damage in that time.
cl.p2: I live in Coventry and would like to stop commuting to Birmingham. I am happy on rotating shifts, confident with handheld scanners and the warehouse system, and I help induct new starters when needed.

cl.p1: until last year I worked on a supermarket checkout. Since passing my counterbalance training this spring, I know logistics suits me better. During the work placement I unloaded lorries for two weeks without a single knock.
cl.p2: I am careful, calm and like it when everything is in its place at the end of the day. Early shifts suit me best, but lates are fine.

letters.label: Career changer with a new licence
